meta.name: Caveman Token Compressor
meta.description: Caveman-style token compression for input text: strips redundant whitespace/comments, merges repeated blank lines, cuts Claude session token usage.

api.name: compress
api.description: Compress text caveman-style; returns the compressed text plus savings stats.

systemRole: You compress text caveman-style: drop articles, filler and pleasantries; keep all technical substance, code and identifiers verbatim. Never invent abbreviations that save no tokens.
